method_name: Connection to an existing district energy or steam system
description: Evaluate an operator-approved connection and temperature-compatible interface.
key_cost_drivers: Interconnection study; heat upgrading; metering; capacity rights
key_carbon_drivers: Upgrade electricity; displaced network heat; losses
required_simulator_inputs: Network temperature/pressure; acceptance constraints; capacity; tariffs; route
notes: Network existence does not imply permission to inject heat or available capacity.

description: Dedicated supply and return pipes connecting heat sources to users.
distance_sensitivity: Strong: pipe length and load density matter
key_carbon_drivers: Pumping; losses; heat-pump electricity; embodied materials
required_simulator_inputs: Source/load temperatures; hourly loads; route; pipe properties; pump curves
notes: No route, diameter or loss coefficient is assumed here.

description: Shared low-temperature water loop with building heat pumps as needed.
key_cost_drivers: Loop; building heat pumps; boreholes if selected
key_carbon_drivers: Grid electricity; thermal balancing; displaced fuel
required_simulator_inputs: Loop limits; building systems; COP maps; loads; source availability
notes: Geothermal boreholes are optional, not an assumed existing asset.

description: Source-to-user exchange where temperature levels permit useful transfer.
typical_source_temperature_class: Source must exceed required sink temperature plus approach
distance_sensitivity: Most attractive at short connection distances
key_cost_drivers: Heat exchanger; short pipe connection; controls
key_carbon_drivers: Pumping; displaced heat; upgrading if needed
required_simulator_inputs: Source/sink temperatures; approach; flow; timing; interface limits
notes: Direct use is conditional; no arbitrary feasibility distance is imposed.

description: Connect multiple independently verified thermal sources and users.
key_carbon_drivers: Source mix; electricity; displaced fuel; distribution losses
required_simulator_inputs: Source time series; temperatures; capacities; ownership; routes; constraints
notes: A pathway category, not an optimized layout or dispatch decision.

description: Add suitable thermal storage to a selected delivery pathway.
typical_source_temperature_class: Compatible with the selected storage and loop
distance_sensitivity: Depends on storage location and network
key_carbon_drivers: Storage losses; charging electricity; displaced peak heat
required_simulator_inputs: Storage limits; losses; charge/discharge power; temperatures; time series
notes: An overlay, not a mutually exclusive transport method or a discovered storage asset.
